canada.title: Debt levels, limits on 'affordability measures,' loom large as House of Assembly returns

canada.summary: Treiva Plamondon’s grandfather Richard Lafferty passed away five years ago, Plamondon says writing ‘Papa’s Magic Fiddle’ became a way to honor her beloved Papa, and move through the grief of losing him.
